title: Meghalaya - Living Roots & Waterfalls
shortDescription: 5D/4N Dawki, Cherrapunji & Mawkdok. Homestays run by women, trek graded.
longDescription: Meghalaya is matrilineal - women own land, and now they lead your trek. Double decker root bridge with safety rope team.
highlights: Double Decker Trek with Local Women
itineraryChangePolicy: Rain may delay treks. Alternative waterfall visits. Safety over itinerary.
